chunks.title: GFIF (Global Finance & Investment Forum at COP31) (GFIF Dealroom) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: GFIF (Global Finance & Investment Forum at COP31) is a Climate Finance Network / Public Facilitator headquartered in Global (COP31 Antalya Dealroom). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Convening lenders, guarantors, DFIs & capital providers in a dedicated COP31 Capital-Provider Dealroom. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Structured climate dealroom connecting project developers, guarantors & DFIs to close bankability gaps at COP31 Antalya. Source verification: https://www.gfif.fund/cop31.

chunks.title: GFIF Dealroom Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: GFIF (Global Finance & Investment Forum at COP31) provides the following climate financing instruments: Capital-Provider Dealroom, Guarantee & Blended Structuring, Co-Investment Syndication. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 1,000,000 to USD 200,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Project SPV, Climate-Tech Startup, Large Corporate, Municipality, Fund Manager.

chunks.title: GFIF Dealroom Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by GFIF (Global Finance & Investment Forum at COP31): Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Renewable Energy, Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Industrial Decarbonization, Climate-Tech Innovation. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Emerging Markets, Türkiye, Africa, Asia. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: GFIF Dealroom Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete GFIF Dealroom's application form: Bankable dealroom teaser with clear capital stack & guarantee needs; Verified climate impact & MRV methodology; Defined pilot or commercial deployment site. Explicit exclusion rules: Unstructured concept ideas lacking financial model. Official application portal: https://www.gfif.fund/cop31.

chunks.title: GFIF Dealroom Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: GFIF (Global Finance & Investment Forum at COP31) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
